hook.name: HHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a floor-price defense and tax system for an H/ETH pool. When the AMM spot price falls below the treasury-backed RFV, beforeSwap intercepts exact-input H sells and redeems them at RFV directly from the treasury (burning the H). A 3% swap tax applies on all non-intercepted swaps—burning H on buys and routing ETH to the treasury on sells—with additional bonding and epoch-based staking rebase mechanics.
